title: Vacuous Fairness Assertion — req Never Asserted
bug_signature: UVM_WARNING: [VACUOUS] Assertion ap_fairness passed 0 times (antecedent never true)
rtl:
// SVA: fairness check
assert property (@(posedge clk) req |-> ##[1:10] gnt);  // No cover — vacuous pass
testbench: task check(); #100; // No requests driven endtask
expected_root_cause: The SVA fairness property uses req as its antecedent but req is never driven high in the test; the implication is vacuously true every cycle and the assertion provides zero coverage of the actual arbitration logic.
fix_replacement:
assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (!rst_n) req |-> ##[1:10] gnt);
cover  property (@(posedge clk) req);  // Ensure antecedent is exercised
description: The SVA fairness check uses `req |-> ##[1:10] gnt` but req is never driven in the test, so the implication is vacuously true and the assertion passes with zero coverage.
failure_log: UVM_WARNING: [VACUOUS] Assertion ap_fairness passed 0 times (antecedent never true)
success_log: Fairness assertion triggered 100 times. Cover property hit 100 times.
